primary_title: Purification and functional reconstitution of the human P2Y12 receptor
decision_basis: Purified human P2Y12 reconstitution supports effective G alpha-i1 coupling as a distinct subtype-specific receptor-proximal edge.
limitations_preserved: Preserve purified human receptor, Gbeta1gamma2, 2MeSADP/ADP, relative subtype coupling and no cell-type, SCI or terminal-TF expansion.
